reference_notes.coordinates: Replace nulls only with measured and user-approved logical iPad coordinates; Android pixels are not interchangeable.
reference_notes.reel_mapping: Upper half retrieves; lower half holds and is not used in this recipe.
reference_notes.requested_reel_count: User requested 10. Fixed mode attempts all 10 unless a bounded stop/error interrupts it; no early catch detection.
reference_notes.timing: 8.1-second hook wait and all converted durations are provisional. Native RPC overhead adds delay; this is not a frame-perfect Android replay. initial_delay runs once; next_cycle_delay=0 adds no pause after Continue before the next CAST; final_wait runs only after the last cycle.
reference_notes.sale: Sell/Continue are fixed timed presses at calibrated points, with no label recognition. Permission for actual scope must already exist.
reference_notes.popups: Optional fixed confirm_popup runs once after result_wait, without image recognition. Fill only a user-approved, verified point. This example is unarmed.
